# ekto

> ekto is an iPhone app for live captions and real-time translation during long meetings, lectures, and face-to-face conversations.

## Summary

- Product type: live caption and translation app
- Platform: iPhone / iOS
- Primary use case: following long meetings and lectures or translating face-to-face conversations in real time
- Positioning: a pocket interpreter for places that were never designed to be accessible or multilingual
- Not primarily for: remote team meetings, Zoom calls, meeting notes, or call transcription workflows

## What ekto does

ekto listens continuously and turns speech into accurate live captions or translated subtitles on an iPhone. It supports 37+ languages and is designed to help people understand fast, quiet, or accented speech without repeatedly asking the speaker to slow down or repeat themselves.

## Use cases

- Long in-person meetings
- Lectures, seminars, and classes
- Conferences and talks
- Tours and museums
- Churches and community events
- Doctor's appointments and waiting rooms
- Everyday face-to-face conversations

## Features

- Live captions
- Real-time translation
- 37+ languages
- Picture-in-picture on iPhone
- No interpreter, AV team, or Zoom transcript required
